_note: GENERATED schema-2 topology, canonical technique IDs and exact Effect copy. Legacy fields are decode/migration payload only.

disciplines.name: Force
disciplines.blurb: Crush, stagger, weight. Answers armoured foes; costs initiative.

nodes.name: Heavy Hand
nodes.blurb: You hit like something heavier than you are.
nodes.effectCopy: Your Crush attacks deal +2 raw damage.

nodes.name: Follow Through
nodes.blurb: Armour is something to go through, not around.
nodes.effectCopy: Deal +3 raw damage to a foe with 8 or more armour before the hit.

nodes.name: Overbear
nodes.blurb: Everything behind the swing, and you pay for it next turn.
nodes.effectCopy: Make a heavy Crush attack now, then skip your next personal turn.

nodes.name: Bracing Stance
nodes.blurb: You did not move, and it shows.
nodes.effectCopy: Deal +3 raw damage while you have held the same rank since your previous action.

nodes.name: Stagger
nodes.blurb: Enough weight and they lose their footing.
nodes.effectCopy: Landed Crush hits have a 30% chance to move the foe one place later next round.

nodes.name: Shatter
nodes.blurb: What it was wearing is not what it is wearing now.
nodes.effectCopy: Strike one foe and permanently reduce its armour for this encounter, to a minimum of 0.

nodes.name: Momentum
nodes.blurb: Slow, and worse for it.
nodes.effectCopy: Gain raw damage from gear initiative penalty: 40% of the penalty, rounded down, maximum +4.

nodes.name: Breaking Blow
nodes.blurb: Through the armour and off their feet.
nodes.effectCopy: Crush hits ignore armour; the first landed Crush hit each personal turn also Staggers.

disciplines.name: Precision
disciplines.blurb: Pierce, gaps, finishing. Answers plated foes; costs raw damage.

nodes.name: Keen Eye
nodes.blurb: You can see where it isn't covered.
nodes.effectCopy: Your Pierce attacks deal +2 raw damage.

nodes.name: Weak Point
nodes.blurb: The thicker it is, the more it has to hide.
nodes.effectCopy: Deal +3 raw damage when the foe's covering density is 50 or more.

nodes.name: Pry
nodes.blurb: Under the armour entirely.
nodes.effectCopy: Make a lower-power Pierce attack that ignores armour.

nodes.name: Steady Hand
nodes.blurb: You do not waste the opening.
nodes.effectCopy: Landed attacks have a 12% chance to deal ×1.5 raw damage before armour.

nodes.name: Exploit
nodes.blurb: Something already wrong with it is something to work with.
nodes.effectCopy: Deal +4 raw damage to a foe with Burn, Poison, Dazzle or Bleed.

nodes.name: Finish
nodes.blurb: It was nearly over.
nodes.effectCopy: Strike one foe at full power below the shown HP threshold, or one-third power above it.

nodes.name: Anatomy
nodes.blurb: You know where everything is, and what it is worth.
nodes.effectCopy: The party gains 35% more butchery output while you took part in the expedition; copies do not stack.

nodes.name: Killing Stroke
nodes.blurb: Below a certain point, there is no fight left in it.
nodes.effectCopy: Defeat a surviving non-apex foe at 15% HP or less after your hit; apexes take +4 damage instead.

disciplines.name: Swiftness
disciplines.blurb: Initiative, extra actions, several targets. Answers swarms.

nodes.name: Quick Step
nodes.blurb: First, more often than not.
nodes.effectCopy: Gain +4 initiative.

nodes.name: Light Touch
nodes.blurb: Heavy gear stops slowing you down so much.
nodes.effectCopy: Halve initiative penalties from equipped gear, rounding toward 0.

nodes.name: Quicken
nodes.blurb: Twice now, nothing after.
nodes.effectCopy: As zero-turn setup, take two ordinary actions now, then skip your next personal turn; cannot combine with Blur.

nodes.name: Second Wind
nodes.blurb: A kill puts something back.
nodes.effectCopy: When you defeat a foe, recover 3 HP if still conscious.

nodes.name: Flurry
nodes.blurb: The swing carries into the next one.
nodes.effectCopy: A landed direct attack carries 40% of damage dealt to one other legal foe; it cannot chain.

nodes.name: First Strike
nodes.blurb: Before it has decided anything.
nodes.effectCopy: As your first normal-cost action, attack for +4 raw damage without allowing retaliation.

nodes.name: Cascade
nodes.blurb: Each one makes the next quicker.
nodes.effectCopy: Each foe you defeat grants +3 initiative for this encounter, up to three times.

nodes.name: Blur
nodes.blurb: Two whole turns, once, when it matters.
nodes.effectCopy: Once per encounter, take two ordinary actions without spending this action; cannot combine with Quicken this turn.

trees.name: Defense
trees.blurb: What they cannot do to you.

disciplines.name: Fortitude
disciplines.blurb: Health, armour, resistance. Answers attrition; costs speed.

nodes.name: Thick Hide
nodes.blurb: There is more of you to get through.
nodes.effectCopy: Gain +6 maximum and starting expedition HP.

nodes.name: Iron Skin
nodes.blurb: Less of what lands, lands.
nodes.effectCopy: Gain +2 armour after equipment and sturdiness.

nodes.name: Brace
nodes.blurb: You take the next one properly.
nodes.effectCopy: Reduce direct damage by 35% through the next hostile action slot that damages you.

nodes.name: Constitution
nodes.blurb: Whatever is in the wound does not stay long.
nodes.effectCopy: Burn, Poison, Dazzle and Bleed on you last half as many rounds, rounded up.

nodes.name: Endurance
nodes.blurb: Hurt, and harder to hurt further.
nodes.effectCopy: At half HP or less, reduce final incoming damage by 25%, without passing the global minimum.

nodes.name: Ward
nodes.blurb: Set against one thing, and set well.
nodes.effectCopy: Choose one disclosed harm kind; reduce matching direct harm by 60% this round and next round.

nodes.name: Unyielding
nodes.blurb: Once, you simply do not fall.
nodes.effectCopy: Once per encounter, harm that would pass you out leaves you at 1 HP.

nodes.name: Immovable
nodes.blurb: Armour is armour, whatever it is against.
nodes.effectCopy: Your armour also applies against Pierce, Heat, Caustic and Light damage.

disciplines.name: Protection
disciplines.blurb: Guarding, drawing, sharing. Answers a fragile back rank.

nodes.name: Bulwark
nodes.blurb: Standing near you is worth something.
nodes.effectCopy: Gain +1 armour; allies in your rank gain +2 armour while you are conscious. Copies use only the strongest bonus.

nodes.name: Watchful
nodes.blurb: You see them before they move.
nodes.effectCopy: If an ordinary creature ambushes the party, cancel its free opening actions and use normal initiative.

nodes.name: Draw Off
nodes.blurb: It comes for you instead.
nodes.effectCopy: Choose one foe; while Draw Off lasts, it targets you whenever legally able.

nodes.name: Cover
nodes.blurb: Some of what was meant for them lands on you.
nodes.effectCopy: While conscious in front, take 30% of final damage aimed at a back-rank ally; Cover cannot chain.

nodes.name: Shieldwall
nodes.blurb: While you're standing, the line holds.
nodes.effectCopy: While conscious in front, every conscious front-rank party member gains +2 armour.

nodes.name: Interpose
nodes.blurb: Not them.
nodes.effectCopy: Receive the next legal hit meant for an ally, then the effect ends.

nodes.name: Rally
nodes.blurb: A kill of yours puts something back into everyone.
nodes.effectCopy: When you defeat a foe, every other conscious party member recovers 2 HP.

nodes.name: Guardian
nodes.blurb: Nothing reaches past you at all.
nodes.effectCopy: While conscious in front, foes cannot directly target the back rank when a legal front target exists.

disciplines.name: Evasion
disciplines.blurb: Dodging, initiative, moving. Answers single heavy hitters.

nodes.name: Footwork
nodes.blurb: Not where the blow is.
nodes.effectCopy: Foes are 6 percentage points more likely to miss you.

nodes.name: Light Frame
nodes.blurb: Nothing on you that you don't need.
nodes.effectCopy: Gain +3 initiative.

nodes.name: Sidestep
nodes.blurb: That one misses.
nodes.effectCopy: The next otherwise legal attack against you misses; its affliction also fails.

nodes.name: Slippery
nodes.blurb: The things that wait for you wait badly.
nodes.effectCopy: Gain a 50% chance to turn an ordinary creature ambush into mutual contact; party copies do not stack.

nodes.name: Fall Back
nodes.blurb: Somewhere else, and still your turn.
nodes.effectCopy: As zero-turn setup, change Front↔Back and keep your ordinary action; this ends Bracing Stance.

nodes.name: Feint
nodes.blurb: Swinging leaves you harder to hit, not easier.
nodes.effectCopy: After your direct attack, gain +10 percentage-point evasion through your next normal-cost action.

nodes.name: Untouchable
nodes.blurb: The longer they miss, the more they miss.
nodes.effectCopy: At round end, gain +5 percentage-point evasion if targeted but not hit, up to +20; a hit resets it.

nodes.name: Ghost
nodes.blurb: The first thing that comes for you finds nothing.
nodes.effectCopy: The first otherwise legal attack against you each encounter misses.

trees.name: Craft
trees.blurb: Not magic — this world has none. Alchemy, concealment and emanation.

disciplines.name: Venom
disciplines.blurb: Toxins, wounds that keep opening, coatings. Answers high-HP foes.

nodes.name: Tainted Edge
nodes.blurb: There is always something on the blade.
nodes.effectCopy: Landed direct weapon hits apply weak Poison: 1 damage for 2 rounds, unless stronger Poison is present.

nodes.name: Apothecary's Hand
nodes.blurb: The same draught goes further with you holding it.
nodes.effectCopy: Beneficial items you use gain +50% magnitude or duration; harmful thrown items are unchanged.

nodes.name: Envenom
nodes.blurb: Properly coated, for a while.
nodes.effectCopy: Arm your next 3 landed physical-weapon hits with Poison 2×3; misses spend no charge.

nodes.name: Virulence
nodes.blurb: It does not wear off when they'd like.
nodes.effectCopy: Afflictions you directly apply last +2 rounds after resistance.

nodes.name: Flense
nodes.blurb: A wound that keeps opening.
nodes.effectCopy: Apply 3 Bleed ticks at 9% of covering insulation, rounded to at least 1 damage per tick.

nodes.name: Corrode
nodes.blurb: What you put on them eats what they're wearing.
nodes.effectCopy: The first tick each round from Poison you applied reduces that foe's armour by 1.

nodes.name: Distiller
nodes.blurb: You waste less making it.
nodes.effectCopy: Coatings prepared for you use 40% fewer positive world-resource ingredients, rounded up; Essence is unchanged.

nodes.name: Blight
nodes.blurb: It spreads.
nodes.effectCopy: New or strengthened Poison you apply copies at half strength and duration to one other foe; it cannot spread again.

disciplines.name: Emanation
disciplines.blurb: Heat, caustic and light emanations—and holding them off. Answers warded and emanating foes.

nodes.name: Sparkhand
nodes.blurb: Something catches where you touch.
nodes.effectCopy: Landed direct weapon hits apply weak Burn: 1 damage for 2 rounds, unless stronger Burn is present.

nodes.name: Insulation
nodes.blurb: One of the three stops mattering so much.
nodes.effectCopy: Choose Heat, Caustic or Light when learned; take 35% less matching emanation damage.

nodes.name: Emanation Strike
nodes.blurb: Strike through a ward with a searing emanation.
nodes.effectCopy: Make a 9-power Heat, Caustic or Light attack, carrying Burn 4×2, Poison 2×4 or Dazzle 0×2.

nodes.name: Attunement
nodes.blurb: What you carry burns hotter.
nodes.effectCopy: Emanation Strike and Channelworks attacks deal +3 raw damage.

nodes.name: Snuff
nodes.blurb: Whatever it was giving off, it isn't now.
nodes.effectCopy: Suppress one foe's active emanation through its next 2 complete hostile turns.

nodes.name: Quench
nodes.blurb: You take it back out of them.
nodes.effectCopy: Choose one ally and remove one selected Burn, Poison or Dazzle; Bleed and unchosen conditions remain.

nodes.name: Conduction
nodes.blurb: It carries to the next one.
nodes.effectCopy: A direct emanation hit carries 50% damage and half-duration affliction to one other foe; it cannot chain.

nodes.name: Emanant
nodes.blurb: You give something off now. Permanently.
nodes.effectCopy: Choose Heat, Caustic or Light when learned. Ordinary direct attacks carry its weak matching affliction; matching Sparkhand or Tainted Edge strengthens that application, while a nonmatching root remains separate.

disciplines.name: Shadow
disciplines.blurb: Concealment, ambush, not being there. Answers fights you'd rather not have.

nodes.name: Quiet Step
nodes.blurb: Fewer things notice you at all.
nodes.effectCopy: Once per ordinary roaming creature, turn its first distant movement detection into one visible alert turn instead of immediate pursuit.

nodes.name: Low Profile
nodes.blurb: They see you late.
nodes.effectCopy: Reduce the party's detection radius by 1 tile. This actor also gains +6 evasion during an ordinary creature ambush's foe-only opening actions.

nodes.name: Conceal
nodes.blurb: Not there, for a moment.
nodes.effectCopy: Through next round, prevent direct targeting while another legal target exists; attacking or intervening reveals you.

nodes.name: Opportunist
nodes.blurb: Coming out of nowhere is worth extra.
nodes.effectCopy: Your first landed direct hit while concealed or in the action when you emerge deals +5 raw damage.

nodes.name: Ambush
nodes.blurb: The fight starts with your turn.
nodes.effectCopy: In an eligible opening, make one shared free direct attack before your first normal-cost action.

nodes.name: Vanish
nodes.blurb: You leave, and the world doesn't charge you for it.
nodes.effectCopy: Once per expedition, the confirmed ordinary combat retreat costs no Stability.

nodes.name: Shadowed
nodes.blurb: All of you are harder to notice.
nodes.effectCopy: Reduce the party's detection radius by 2 tiles, replacing Low Profile's field reduction but not its personal ambush-opening evasion.

nodes.name: Unseen
nodes.blurb: Every fight begins with them looking for you.
nodes.effectCopy: Begin ordinary encounters concealed through the end of the first ordinary round; this does not cancel an ambush.
